purpose: Evaluate draft sentiment measurements and candidate parameters; do not create a skill or claim executable strategy returns.

data.source: BaoStock public historical daily bars; independent Shanghai index check with Longbridge where possible
data.universe: Historical stock_basic listing/delisting dates, Shanghai and Shenzhen A shares, including subsequently delisted securities if source supplies history; no current survivor-only selection
data.primary: Main board, each date trading, non-ST, at least 60 exchange sessions since IPO; raw prices consistent with reconstructed 10% limits
data.secondary: ChiNext and STAR separately, with their historical limit regimes; Beijing not included
data.vintage_limitation: Data downloaded now; reconstructed historical information, not archived point-in-time releases; isST and bar coverage depend on vendor
data.limit_limitation: Price limits reconstructed from raw preclose and board regime with cent half-up rounding. Not a verified exchange daily limit-price file. Special resumptions/delisting flags can be incomplete.

split.purge: For each forward horizon, exclude observations whose end date crosses that split boundary

metrics: 20/60-day close new highs and lows on chained return series
previous-session limit-up cohort median, positive fraction and lower-decile return
test_design: One-factor-at-a-time comparisons around default, no full Cartesian search; simple breadth and previous-limit-up-outcome baselines; compare both years in holdout and market segments; retain default unless validation and holdout support stable material improvement; report failures and selection uncertainty
direction: Compare each group's proxy to prior k-session median: G=net advance, A=limit-up share, P=previous limit-up median return, R=negative limit-down share. Improving requires at least m positive deltas, positive P level and nonnegative R delta; deteriorating requires at least m negative deltas, nonpositive P level and nonpositive R delta. Exact ties are neutral. This is a test implementation, not an already validated definition.
dual_axes: Damage easing: limit-down share below prior-3 median AND market lower-decile return above prior-3 median. Profit diffusion: previous-limit-up cohort median positive AND positive-return fraction > 0.5. Compare the four cells, with missing P excluded rather than filled.
labels: Descriptive stages are algorithmic hypotheses, not human ground truth. Low/high require at least two group percentiles below q/above 1-q. Repair combines improvement with recent low state; expansion is improvement without recent low; divergence combines recent high and weakening; retreat combines deterioration and lower G percentile. Primary parameter evaluation uses numeric forward outcomes, not agreement with these labels.
forward_outcomes: Frozen day-t eligible cohort mean compounded total-adjustment proxy return to t+1,t+3,t+5, using product(1+pctChg/100), plus up fraction and next-day downside breadth. No assumed fills at signal-day close. Missing future bars not zero-filled; report retention and do not call these trading PnL.
event_cohorts: At t: close above all previous 20 closes on chained return series; same breakout plus turnover amount > 1.2/1.5/2.0 times prior20 median; first limit-up after previous nonlimit-up. At t+h report cohort mean return and excess over same-day broad market cohort. Only matured cohorts enter summaries.
uncertainty: Resample contiguous blocks of 10 trading dates, 1000 replicates, for holdout forward-5-day mean-return differences; chronological splits, overlapping outcome purge and daily aggregation reduce false stock-level sample size claims. Intervals are descriptive and not multiple-testing-adjusted. Sensitivity 5/20 blocks for principal result.
not_tested: PIT concept membership and theme birthday
minute-level opening/resealing counts and auction order book
executable strategy profitability after costs and T+1/limit locks
amendment_policy: Any data-driven exclusions, unavailable fields or changed implementation must be recorded explicitly; no silent parameter retuning after holdout results.
